bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$db" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -F: -c "SELECT feature,CASE WHEN enabled AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(COALESCE(telegram_dm_e2e_evidence,telegram_e2e_evidence)))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL THEN 'READY' ELSE 'NOT_READY' END FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature IN ('profile','announcement','room','link','search','help') ORDER BY feature;" || exit 72
c="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test -n "$c" || exit 73
docker logs "$c" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 74
echo MENU_RELEASE_GATES_READBACK_PASS
